How Talview Can help You
Hire Skilled Workforce Remotely
Conduct secure, proctored interviews across geographies and choose the best fit. Our AI-driven video interviews ensure authenticity, fairness, and data-driven evaluations—making remote hiring more secure and efficient.
Scalable Exam Delivery for Workforce Upskilling
As energy companies invest in upskilling programs for new tech, Talview provides a proctoring-enabled platform to deliver scalable, secure training assessments, ensuring learning outcomes are achieved with integrity.
Accelerated Skills Validationation
Quickly onboarding skilled contract workers is critical for time-sensitive energy projects. Talview offers secure, proctored assessments to validate technical know-how, safety awareness, and regulatory understanding—so you can trust your workforce from day one.
Secure Proctoring for Safety & Compliance Certifications
From Health & Safety training to equipment handling credentials, energy companies rely on certified professionals to maintain operational safety. Our remote proctoring platform ensures integrity and compliance for high-stakes assessments, reducing fraud risk and enabling secure testing across global locations, including offshore and remote sites.
